HatchLibrary__Meta.Meta__Description: The hatch pattern library: every pack the Patterns panel offers. Each pack is a folder holding its own HatchPack__Index__.json and its pattern files.
HatchLibrary__Meta.Meta__WhyAnIndex: Nothing lists a directory - not GitHub Pages, not the Flask dev server. A pack folder that is not listed here is invisible to the editor. A pack listed here with no index file does not break the panel - the loader skips it - but the browser still prints a red 404 for it in the console on every load, and no script can hide that. So an empty folder costs nothing only while it is NOT listed.
HatchLibrary__Meta.Meta__HowToAddAPack: Make the folder, put a HatchPack__Index__.json in it listing its patterns, then add a row below - in that order. No code changes.
HatchLibrary__Meta.Meta__EmptyPacks: On disk, empty, and deliberately not listed until each has a HatchPack__Index__.json: 01__GeometricHatches (Pack__Key GeometricHatches, label 'Geometric' - cross hatches, diagonals, stipples), 02__ConstructionMaterialHatches (Pack__Key ConstructionMaterialHatches, label 'Construction Materials' - brick, block, insulation, concrete), and 03__Placeholder / 04__Placeholder (not yet named).
